definitions.explanation: Colored pigments used for painting and drawing, such as watercolors, oil paints, or acrylic paints. A standard school supply in Japan.

examples.japanese: {絵|え}の{具|ぐ}で{絵|え}を{描|か}いた。
examples.english: I painted a picture with paints.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}い{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}が{足|た}りなくなった。
examples.english: I ran out of red paint.

examples.japanese: {図工|ずこう}の{時間|じかん}に{水彩|すいさい}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}を{使|つか}って{風景画|ふうけいが}を{描|か}いた。
examples.english: During art class, I used watercolors to paint a landscape.

notes:
USAGE:
{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} is the general word for art paints. It is a standard item in Japanese school supplies, with {水彩|すいさい}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (watercolors) being the most common type used in elementary school art classes ({図工|ずこう}). The word {具|ぐ} here means "tool" or "material."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水彩|すいさい}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (watercolor paints)
- {油|あぶら}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (oil paints)
- {絵|え}の{具|ぐ}セット (paint set)
- {絵|え}の{具|ぐ}を{混|ま}ぜる (to mix paints)
